en: And they have strange wounds on their necks.
Have you had any odd symptoms?
With dreadful crimes and a strange illness,
London's gone odd, hasn't it?
What on earth could be the cause?
Do come again any time.
I only came by to pay my respects.
I may not look it, but I'm very robust.
Thank you. I'll be going, then.
(Oh dear. If he examined me, he'd find out
that I'm not human.)
I just came to pay my respects.
I may not look it, but I'm the hardy sort.
N-no, that's quite all right.
I don't mind just talking with you, but
the truth is, I'm not good with doctors.
What a surprising weakness. That won't do.
You'll ruin your health that way.
No, I've come to the wrong place. Sorry.
(A doctor's house. That was a mistake.)
Come in. You're most welcome.
He alone has noticed the change in everyone.
No one but him would ever notice.
Yes, if only he weren't here...
I can't let him find out.
There's no other way.
You'll have to become
my servant.
note: Also listed alone in msg 173576 (probably a decoder branch artefact, as in the slice 000 report); check in game.

en: They say God judges the sins of men...
But then who will judge ours...
I beg you, let your Wilfred serve you.
note: Ends as a full sentence because the next row #4358 (slice 054) also stands alone after '{NAME}, my master.' in msg 172684.

en: What's this wound?
I know, it's the work of someone with a grudge against me.
, my master. What is your wish?
I will do anything...
I've been feeling tired lately, somehow...
Maybe I'll just have a drink and go to bed.
Well, well, welcome, welcome!
What can I do for you, sir?
Judging by your fine attire...
you're not here to pawn anything.
Ah, I know. You're interested in antiques?
No, I've only come to look today.
I see, I see.
Please, take your time and look around.
Drop by often, and you might just
find a real treasure.
Thank you for visiting our shop, sir.
Always so distinguished. I'm most impressed.
Do antiques interest you, sir?
We have a fine stock of rare pieces.
When something rare comes in, I'll let you know.
Welcome, sir.
Well now, what are you looking for today?
Times are hard, so some folk are selling off
antiques so precious you'd hardly believe it.
Now's your chance.
We're really a pawnshop, you know,
but we've long doubled as an antique shop.
It started as my old man's hobby,
but I built it up into a real business.
What do you think?
You'd be surprised what wonderful pieces
hide among common folk's pawned goods.
I get them for a song, and then...
Oops, I shouldn't have said that.
Isn't it time? Won't you choose a piece
to add to your collection?
I'm always glad to help.
Who is it?
Here to pawn? We're closed at this hour.
The antique shop's only open by day, too.
Please come during business hours.
Many thanks for your patronage, as ever.
What brings you here at this hour...
Something to discuss in private?
For you, sir, I could let my best pieces
go a little cheaper.
But that's our secret.
Welcome, sir, so good of you to come.
